						if (finished) return;
						if (size + chunk.byteLength > maxFileSize || chunk.byteLength > remaining) return fail(new Constants.Error.Error(entry.name, "Decompressed image or aggregate archive output exceeds the upload limit."));

					}).on("error", fail).on("end", () => { if (!finished) { finished = true; resolve(new Blob(chunks as BlobPart[])); chunks = []; } }).resume();
				});

				const type = ext === "png" ? "image/png" : ext === "gif" ? "image/gif" : "image/jpeg";
				files.push(new File([blob], entry.name, { type }));
			}
			return files;
		} catch (error) {
			if (error instanceof Constants.Error.Error) throw error;
			throw new Constants.Error.Error(file.name, "Failed to extract archive");
		}
	};

	const splitImage = async (image: HTMLImageElement, name: string) => {
		if (image.width > image.height) {
			const slices = Math.ceil(image.width / maxImageWidth);
			const sliceWidth = Math.ceil(image.width / slices);

			const images = [];
			for (let i = 0; i < slices; i++) {
				const x = sliceWidth * i;
				const remainingWidth = image.width - x;

				const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
				canvas.width = Math.min(sliceWidth, remainingWidth);
				canvas.height = image.height;

				const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
				ctx.drawImage(
					image,
					x,
					0,
					Math.min(sliceWidth, remainingWidth),
					image.height,
					0,
					0,
					Math.min(sliceWidth, remainingWidth),
					image.height
				);

				const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/png", 100));
				if (blob) images.push(new File([blob], name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") + "_" + i + ".png", { type: "image/png" }));
			}

			return images;
		}

		const slices = Math.ceil(image.height / maxImageHeight);
		const sliceHeight = Math.ceil(image.height / slices);

		const images = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < slices; i++) {
			const y = sliceHeight * i;
			const remainingHeight = image.height - y;

			const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
			canvas.width = image.width;
			canvas.height = Math.min(sliceHeight, remainingHeight);

			const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
			ctx.drawImage(
				image,
				0,
				y,
				image.width,
				Math.min(sliceHeight, remainingHeight),
				0,
				0,
				image.width,
				Math.min(sliceHeight, remainingHeight)
			);

			const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/png", 100));
			if (blob) images.push(new File([blob], name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") + "_" + i + ".png", { type: "image/png" }));
		}
		return images;
	};

	const breakpoints: Record<number, number> = {
		0: 5,
		960: 4,
		770: 3,
		580: 2
	};
	const calcColumns = () => {
		for (const k in breakpoints) {
			const w = Number(k);
			const v = breakpoints[w];

			if (window.innerWidth <= w) {
				return v;
			}
		}
		return breakpoints[0];
	};
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { getUploadOwner, runUploadBatch, resolveUploadPage, markUnsentUploadPages, replaceUploadPage, reconcileUploadReplacement, acknowledge } from "$publicApi/native-upload-client";
	import { Constants } from "$lib";
	import AspectRatio from "$lib/components/ui/aspect-ratio/aspect-ratio.svelte";
	import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
	import Label from "$lib/components/ui/label/label.svelte";
	import { Progress } from "$lib/components/ui/progress/index.js";
	import { Spinner } from "$lib/components/ui/spinner";

	import { flip } from "svelte/animate";

	import UploadChapterPagesEntry from "./UploadChapterPagesEntry.svelte";

	let {
		pages = $bindable(),
		disabled: propDisabled
	}: {
		pages: UploadSessionFile[];
		disabled?: boolean;
	} = $props();

	const uploadSession = $derived(getUploadSession()());
	const disabled = $derived(propDisabled || uploadSession?.can_mutate === false);
	const mutex = getMutex();
	const owner = getUploadOwner();

	let ref = $state<HTMLInputElement>();
	let columns = $derived<number>(calcColumns());
	let progress = $state({ total: 0, loaded: 0 });

	let isDragDisabled = $state(true);

	onDestroy(() => {
		pages.forEach(revokeThumbnail);
	});

	const createPage = (file: File) => {
		// The upload queue and rendered array must share this exact reactive row.
		// Mutating a pre-proxy raw row after an awaited request is invisible.
		const candidate = $state(<UploadSessionFile>{
			id: crypto.randomUUID(),
			original_file_name: file.name,

			file: file,
			thumbnail: URL.createObjectURL(file)
		});
		return candidate;
	};

	const revokeThumbnail = (page: UploadSessionFile) => {
		if (page.thumbnail && page.thumbnail.startsWith("blob:")) {
			if (!revokeUploadPreviewUrl(page.thumbnail)) URL.revokeObjectURL(page.thumbnail);
		}
	};

	const uploadChunk = async (chunk: UploadSessionFile[], onProgress?: (delta: number) => void) => {
		if (!uploadSession) return;
		const session = uploadSession;
		try {
			const result = await runUploadBatch(session, chunk, owner, onProgress, () => assertFileSession(session)); assertFileSession(session);
			if (uploadSession !== session || session.can_mutate === false) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Upload changed", "Old batch results were discarded. No mutation was replayed.");

			pages = pages;
		} catch (error) { if (owner.alive()) pages = pages; throw error; }
	};

	// Parent disabled includes this same mutex. Admit the gesture before locking,
	// then retain exact owner/session authority across every asynchronous decode.
	const assertFileSession = (session: UploadSession) => {
		owner.assert();
		if (uploadSession !== session || session.can_mutate === false) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Upload changed", "Old file selection was discarded. No mutation was replayed.");
	};
	const fileSession = () => !disabled && !mutex.isLocked() && uploadSession && uploadSession.can_mutate !== false ? uploadSession : undefined;
	let targetFile = $state<UploadSessionFile>();
	const keepReplacementFence = (session: UploadSession) => {
		if (owner.pendingReplacement()?.sessionId !== session.id) return;
		session.can_mutate = false; session.can_cancel = false; session.can_retry_commit = false;
	};
	const adoptReplacement = (session: UploadSession, saved: UploadSession, replacement: UploadSessionFile, target: UploadSessionFile, local?: File) => {
		owner.assert();
		const idx = pages.indexOf(target);
		if (uploadSession !== session || saved.id !== session.id || idx < 0 || replacement.id !== target.id) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Upload changed", "The confirmed replacement belongs to an older page selection. Reload its exact staging; no request was replayed.");
		const retained = replacement.file_hash === target.file_hash && replacement.file_size === target.file_size;
		const thumbnail = retained ? target.thumbnail : local ? URL.createObjectURL(local) : undefined;
		const previous = { ...target };
		// Preserve an existing preview lease, but remount a confirmed same-key card
		// without a thumbnail: its prior signed-preview attempt may have been fenced.
		if (retained && !thumbnail) pages[idx] = { ...replacement, thumbnail };
		else Object.assign(target, replacement, { thumbnail });
		pages = pages;
		acknowledge(session, saved);
		if (!retained) revokeThumbnail(previous);
	};
	const checkSignedReplacement = () => mutex.wait(async () => {
		const session = uploadSession, pending = owner.pendingReplacement();
		if (!session || !pending || pending.sessionId !== session.id) return;
		const target = pages.find(page => page.id === pending.fileId);
		if (!target) return;
		try {
			const confirmed = await reconcileUploadReplacement(owner);
			adoptReplacement(session, confirmed.session, confirmed.file, target);
			toast.success("Replacement confirmed", { description: "The exact staged page receipt was read. No replacement request was replayed." });
		} catch (error) {
			if (!owner.alive() || uploadSession !== session) return;
			keepReplacementFence(session);
			const visible = error instanceof Constants.Error.Error ? error : Constants.Error.Unknown;
			toast.error(visible.title, { description: visible.body });
		}
	});
	const replaceFile = async (file: File, session: UploadSession) => {
		assertFileSession(session);
		const target = targetFile, idx = target ? pages.indexOf(target) : -1;
		if (!target || idx < 0) return;
		const current = () => {
			owner.assert();
			if (uploadSession !== session || targetFile !== target || pages[idx] !== target) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Upload changed", "Old replacement selection was discarded. No mutation was replayed.");
		};
		if (target.upload_recovery?.state === "unknown") throw new Constants.Error.Error("Reconcile upload first", "This page's attachment outcome is unresolved. Read its exact staging receipt before selecting a replacement.");
		if (!imageMimeTypes.includes(file.type) || !file.size || file.size > maxFileSize) throw new Constants.Error.Error(file.name, "Replacement must be a valid image within the 25 MiB page limit. Existing page is retained.");
		const decoded = await decodeUploadImage(file); current();
		if (decoded.width > maxImageWidth || decoded.height > maxImageHeight) throw new Constants.Error.Error(file.name, "A replacement must fit one bounded page. Add this image normally to split it; existing page is retained.");
		const total = pages.reduce((sum, page) => sum + Number(page.file_size ?? page.file?.size ?? 0), 0), previousSize = Number(target.file_size ?? target.file?.size ?? 0);
		if (!Number.isFinite(total) || !Number.isFinite(previousSize) || pages.length > maxSessionFiles || total - previousSize + file.size > maxSessionSize) throw new Constants.Error.Error(file.name, "Replacement exceeds the 500-page/500 MiB session budget. Existing page is retained.");
		// A provably local unsent/rejected row has no durable old file to replace.
		if (target.file || target.error) {
			const candidate = createPage(file); pages[idx] = candidate;
			try { await uploadChunk([candidate]); assertFileSession(session); revokeThumbnail(target); }
			catch (error) { if (owner.alive() && uploadSession === session) { if (candidate.upload_recovery?.state !== "unknown") { pages[idx] = target; revokeThumbnail(candidate); } else revokeThumbnail(target); } throw error; }
			return;
		}
		try {
			const confirmed = await replaceUploadPage(session, target, file, owner, current); current();
			adoptReplacement(session, confirmed.session, confirmed.file, target, file);
		} catch (error) { if (owner.alive() && uploadSession === session) keepReplacementFence(session); throw error; }
	};

	const inspectImageDimensions = async (file: File) => {
		const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 1024 * 1024).arrayBuffer());
		const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
		let width = 0, height = 0;
		if (bytes.length >= 24 && bytes[0] === 137 && bytes[1] === 80 && bytes[2] === 78 && bytes[3] === 71) { width = view.getUint32(16); height = view.getUint32(20); }
		else if (bytes.length >= 10 && String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(0, 3)) === "GIF") { width = view.getUint16(6, true); height = view.getUint16(8, true); }
		else if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 255 && bytes[1] === 216) {
			let offset = 2;
			while (offset + 4 <= bytes.length) {
				if (bytes[offset++] !== 255) break;
				while (bytes[offset] === 255) offset++;
				const marker = bytes[offset++];
				if (marker === 217 || marker === 218) break;
				if (marker === 1 || marker >= 208 && marker <= 215) continue;

				const length = view.getUint16(offset);
				if (length < 2 || offset + length > bytes.length) break;

		});
	};
	const processFiles = async (files: File[], session: UploadSession) => {
		assertFileSession(session);
		if (files.length > maxSessionFiles || pages.length + files.length > maxSessionFiles) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Too many upload files", "A session admits at most 500 pages. Split large folders into smaller selections.");
		const admittedSessionSize = pages.reduce((total, page) => total + Number(page.file_size ?? page.file?.size ?? 0), 0);
		let remaining = maxSessionSize - admittedSessionSize;
		const processedFiles: File[] = [];
		// One decoder at a time bounds memory; no Promise.all over untrusted files.
		const admit = async (file: File) => {
			if (file.size > maxFileSize) throw new Constants.Error.Error(file.name, "File too large");
			const decoded = await decodeUploadImage(file); assertFileSession(session);
			const pieces = decoded.width > maxImageWidth || decoded.height > maxImageHeight ? await splitImage(decoded, file.name) : [file];
			assertFileSession(session);
			for (const piece of pieces) {
				if (pages.length + processedFiles.length >= maxSessionFiles || piece.size > maxFileSize || piece.size > remaining) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Upload limit exceeded", "The decoded selection exceeds 500 pages or the 500 MiB session budget.");
				remaining -= piece.size; processedFiles.push(piece);
			}
		};
		for (const file of files) {
			if (imageMimeTypes.includes(file.type)) await admit(file);
			else if (archiveMimeTypes.includes(file.type) || /\.(cbz|zip)$/i.test(file.name)) {
				const extracted = await extractArchive(file, remaining, maxSessionFiles - pages.length - processedFiles.length); assertFileSession(session);
				for (const image of extracted) await admit(image);
			}
		}
		if (!processedFiles.length) return;

		const totalSize = processedFiles.reduce<number>((acc, file) => acc + file.size, 0);
		const sessionSize = pages.reduce<number>((acc, file) => acc + Number(file.file_size ?? file.file?.size ?? 0), 0);

		if (totalSize + sessionSize >= maxSessionSize) {
			toast.error("Maximum size for this upload session exceeded.");
			return;
		}
		progress.total += totalSize;

		processedFiles.sort((a, b) =>
			a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, {
				numeric: true,
				sensitivity: "base"
			})
		);

		assertFileSession(session);
		const newFiles = processedFiles.map(createPage);
		pages.push(...newFiles);

		while (newFiles.length) {
			const chunk: UploadSessionFile[] = [];
			for (
				let j = 0;
				j < maxChunkFiles && (chunk.length ? chunk.reduce((acc, file) => acc + file.file!.size, 0) : 0) < maxChunkSize;
				j++

				chunk.push(file);
			}

		}

		if (progress.loaded >= progress.total) {
			setTimeout(() => {
				progress = { total: 0, loaded: 0 };
			}, 1000);
		}
	};

	const scanFiles = async (entry?: FileSystemEntry | null, budget = { files: 0, entries: 0, bytes: 0 }, depth = 0): Promise<File[]> => {
		if (!entry) return [];
		if (++budget.entries > 2048 || depth > 16) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Folder exceeds upload limits", "Limit the selection to 500 files, 2048 entries and 16 nested directories.");
		if (entry.isFile) {
			if (++budget.files > maxSessionFiles) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Too many upload files", "A selection admits at most 500 files.");
			const file = await new Promise<File>((resolve, reject) => (<FileSystemFileEntry>entry).file(resolve, reject));
			budget.bytes += file.size;
			if (budget.bytes > maxSessionSize) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Folder exceeds upload limits", "Selected input exceeds 500 MiB.");
			return [file];
		}
		if (!entry.isDirectory) return [];
		const reader = (entry as FileSystemDirectoryEntry).createReader(), files: File[] = [];
		while (true) {
			const entries = await new Promise<FileSystemEntry[]>((resolve, reject) => reader.readEntries(resolve, reject));
			if (!entries.length) break;
			for (const child of entries) files.push(...await scanFiles(child, budget, depth + 1));
		}
		return files;
	};

	const onInputChange = (ev: Event) => {
		const session = fileSession();
		if (!session) { targetFile = undefined; (ev.target as HTMLInputElement).value = ""; return; }

			const target = ev.target as HTMLInputElement;
			try {
				if (target.files?.length) {
					if (targetFile) await replaceFile(target.files[0], session);
					else await processFiles(Array.from(target.files), session);
				}
			} catch (e) {
				if (!owner.alive() || uploadSession !== session) return;
				if (e instanceof Constants.Error.Error) toast.error(e.title, { description: e.body });
				else {
					console.error(e);
					toast.error(Constants.Error.Unknown.title, { description: Constants.Error.Unknown.body });
				}
			} finally {
				targetFile = undefined;
				target.value = "";
			}
		});
	};

	const onDrop = (ev: DragEvent) => {
		ev.preventDefault();
		const session = fileSession();
		if (!session) return;
		return mutex.exec(async () => {
			try {
				if (ev.dataTransfer?.items.length) {
					const budget = { files: 0, entries: 0, bytes: 0 };
					const files: File[][] = [];
					if (ev.dataTransfer.items.length > maxSessionFiles) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Too many upload files", "A selection admits at most 500 roots.");
					for (const item of Array.from(ev.dataTransfer.items)) files.push(await scanFiles(item.webkitGetAsEntry(), budget));
					assertFileSession(session);
					await processFiles(files.flat().filter(e => e instanceof File), session);
				} else if (ev.dataTransfer?.files.length) {
					await processFiles(Array.from(ev.dataTransfer.files), session);
				}
			} catch (e) {
				if (!owner.alive() || uploadSession !== session) return;
				if (e instanceof Constants.Error.Error) toast.error(e.title, { description: e.body });
				else {
					console.error(e);
					toast.error(Constants.Error.Unknown.title, { description: Constants.Error.Unknown.body });
				}
			}
		});
	};

	let isDeletingPages = $state(false);
	const deletePages = () =>
		mutex.exec(async () => {
			if (!uploadSession) {
				return;
			}

			isDeletingPages = true;
			try {
				const resolved: UploadSessionFile[] = [];
				for (const page of pages) resolved.push(await resolveUploadPage(uploadSession, page, owner));
				owner.assert();
				const ids = [...new Set(resolved.filter(e => !e.file && !e.error).map(e => e.id))];
				if (ids.length) {
					const res = await owner.request(`/upload/${uploadSession.id}/batch`, "DELETE", ids);
					if (res?.status === StatusCodes.OK) {
					} else if (res?.status === StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN) {
						throw Constants.Error.Forbidden;
					} else if (res?.status === StatusCodes.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS) {
						throw Constants.Error.TooManyRequests;
					} else throw Constants.Error.Unknown;
				}

				owner.assert(); pages.forEach(revokeThumbnail);
				pages = [];
			} catch (e) {
				if (e instanceof Constants.Error.Error) toast.error(e.title, { description: e.body });
				else {
					console.error(e);
					toast.error(Constants.Error.Unknown.title, { description: Constants.Error.Unknown.body });
				}
			} finally {
				isDeletingPages = false;
			}
		});

	let isDeletingDuplicate = $state(false);
	const deleteDuplicate = () => mutex.exec(async () => {
		if (!uploadSession || uploadSession.can_mutate === false) return;
		const sessionId = uploadSession.id;
		isDeletingDuplicate = true;
		try {
			owner.assert();
			if (pages.some(page => page.upload_recovery?.state === "unknown")) throw new Constants.Error.Error("Reconcile upload first", "Unknown page outcomes cannot be discarded as duplicates. Reload exact owner staging or explicitly cancel this upload.");
			const unique = new Map<string | symbol, UploadSessionFile>(), discarded: UploadSessionFile[] = [], remoteIds: string[] = [];
			for (const row of pages) {
				// Only acknowledged full server hashes prove content equality.
				const key = !row.file && !row.error && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(row.file_hash ?? "") ? row.file_hash : Symbol("unproven page");
				if (unique.has(key)) { discarded.push(row); if (!row.file && !row.error) remoteIds.push(row.id); }
				else unique.set(key, row);
			}
			if (remoteIds.length) {
				const res = await owner.request(`/upload/${sessionId}/batch`, "DELETE", remoteIds); owner.assert();
				if (res?.status !== StatusCodes.OK) throw res?.status === StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN ? Constants.Error.Forbidden : res?.status === StatusCodes.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS ? Constants.Error.TooManyRequests : res?.status === StatusCodes.CONFLICT ? Constants.Error.UpdateConflict : Constants.Error.Unknown;
			}
			owner.assert(); if (uploadSession?.id !== sessionId) throw Constants.Error.UpdateConflict;
			const kept = Array.from(unique.values()); pages = kept;
			const retainedUrls = new Set(kept.map(row => row.thumbnail));
			for (const thumbnail of new Set(discarded.map(row => row.thumbnail))) if (thumbnail?.startsWith("blob:") && !retainedUrls.has(thumbnail)) { if (!revokeUploadPreviewUrl(thumbnail)) URL.revokeObjectURL(thumbnail); }
			if (kept.some(row => row.file || row.error || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(row.file_hash ?? ""))) toast.info("Unproven duplicates were kept", { description: "Only acknowledged identical content hashes qualify. Matching filenames do not prove identical images; no upload was replayed." });
		} catch (cause) { const error = cause instanceof Constants.Error.Error ? cause : Constants.Error.Unknown; toast.error(error.title, { description: error.body }); }
		finally { isDeletingDuplicate = false; }
	});

	const handleDragAndDropEvent = (e: CustomEvent<DndEvent<UploadSessionFile>>) => {
		if (disabled || mutex.isLocked() || uploadSession?.can_mutate === false) return;
		pages = e.detail.items;
		isDragDisabled = true;
	};

	const createDragToggleHandler = (shouldEnable: boolean) => () => (isDragDisabled = !shouldEnable || !!disabled || uploadSession?.can_mutate === false);
</script>

<input class="hidden" type="file" multiple accept={imageMimeTypes.join(",")} onchange={onInputChange} bind:this={ref} />
{#if progressPercentage > 0}
	<div class="bg-background sticky top-15 z-10 -mx-4 px-4 pb-2" transition:fade={{ duration: 200 }}>
		<Progress value={progressPercentage} />
	</div>

<div class="space-y-4">
	{#if uploadSession?.can_mutate === false && owner.pendingReplacement()?.sessionId === uploadSession.id}
		<div role="status" class="space-y-2">

			<Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={$mutex} onclick={checkSignedReplacement}>Check replacement status</Button>
		</div>
	{/if}
	<Label>
		Pages
		{#if pages.length}
			({pages.length})
		{/if}
	</Label>
	<div
		class="grid grid-cols-[repeat(var(--columns),minmax(0,1fr))] gap-8 select-none"
		use:dndzone={{
			items: pages,
			flipDurationMs: 100,
			dragDisabled: isDragDisabled,
			dropTargetStyle: { outline: "none" }
		}}
		onconsider={handleDragAndDropEvent}
		onfinalize={handleDragAndDropEvent}
		style="--columns: {columns}"
	>
		{#each pages as page, i (page)}
			{@const isDragging = (page as any)[SHADOW_ITEM_MARKER_PROPERTY_NAME]}
			<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_static_element_interactions -->
			<div
				class="!visible relative !border-none !ring-0"
				class:dragging={isDragging}
				animate:flip={{ duration: 100 }}
				onmouseenter={createDragToggleHandler(!$mutex)}
				onmouseleave={createDragToggleHandler(false)}
				onmousedown={createDragToggleHandler(false)}
				onmouseup={createDragToggleHandler(!$mutex)}
				ontouchstart={createDragToggleHandler(false)}
				ontouchend={createDragToggleHandler(!$mutex)}
			>
				<UploadChapterPagesEntry
					bind:page={pages[i]}
					bind:pages
					bind:targetFile
					inputRef={ref}
					{isDragging}
					disabled={$mutex || disabled}
				/>
			</div>
		{/each}
		<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_static_element_interactions -->
		<div>
			<AspectRatio ratio={10 / 14}>
				<Button
					class="size-full rounded-md border border-dashed !bg-transparent"
					variant="outline"
					onclick={() => ref?.click()}
					disabled={$mutex || disabled}
				>
					<PlusIcon class="size-6" />
				</Button>
			</AspectRatio>
		</div>
	</div>
	{#if pages.length > 1}
		<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
			<Button
				class="border-none"
				variant="outline"
				type="button"
				onclick={() =>
					pages.sort((a, b) =>
						(a.original_file_name ?? a.file_name).localeCompare(b.original_file_name ?? b.file_name, undefined, {
							numeric: true,
							sensitivity: "base"
						})
					)}
				disabled={$mutex || disabled}
			>
				Quick Sort
			</Button>
			<Button
				class="w-40 border-none"
				variant="outline"
				type="button"
				onclick={deletePages}
				disabled={$mutex || disabled}
			>
				{#if $mutex && isDeletingPages}
					<Spinner />
				{:else}
					Remove all pages
				{/if}
			</Button>
			<Button
				class="w-40 border-none"
				variant="outline"
				type="button"
				onclick={deleteDuplicate}
				disabled={$mutex || disabled}
			>
				{#if $mutex && isDeletingDuplicate}
					<Spinner />
				{:else}
					Remove duplicates
				{/if}
			</Button>
		</div>
	{/if}
</div>

<style>
